Mbed TLS 3.6.7 (the 3.6 LTS line)

          checked against the release's own mbedtls-3.6.7-sha256sum.txt AND
          GitHub's asset digest before vendoring (2026-09-29)

Vendored: LICENSE, include/ and library/ from the tarball, unchanged. The
default include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h is used as shipped (no
MBEDTLS_CONFIG_FILE); build.zig compiles every library/*.c.

HISTORY. Vendored at 3.6.2 on 2026-07-15 (c40af1a3b) and never updated
until 2026-09-29, when the stzlib-security plane moved it to 3.6.7. The
versions skipped carry security fixes -- 3.6.7 alone fixes a remote
buffer overflow in the TLS 1.2 ECDHE-PSK client handshake. 3.6.3 and
later also REFUSE a client that verifies without setting a hostname,
which the reactor already does on both client paths.

UPDATING: take LICENSE, include/ and library/ from a newer 3.6.x tarball,
verify its SHA-256 against the release's sum file, replace this record,
and run base/test/security/tls_fail_closed_narrated.ring,
base/test/cluster/mtls_narrated.ring, `zig build fuzz-tls mtls-smoke`,
and engine/tools/sbom.py --check.
